channel.title: Sierra Leone - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Sierra Leone, every source cited.

item.title: Female artisanal miners report sexual violence in Kono district
item.description: Women working in the diamond-rich Jaiama Nimikor area describe systemic rape and harassment while scavenging for gold and diamonds in abandoned pits.

item.title: Sierra Leone charcoal burning causes deforestation
item.description: Environmental agency confirms burning of economic trees threatens food security and exacerbates climate change effects.

item.title: African youth protest governance amid economic hardship
item.description: Protests erupted in Kenya, Tanzania, Morocco and other nations as citizens questioned growth figures.

item.title: Two Sierra Leone police officers to study forensic science in India
item.description: The officers will gain advanced knowledge in scientific evidence analysis and modern crime detection techniques.

item.title: Security guard jailed for stealing CCTV camera
item.description: Alie Sesay received a six-month sentence for taking a camera valued at Le2,540 in Freetown.
